BLOCKTALK / EAGLERCRAFT TOOLS

Minecraft skin & cape editor

Create a standard PNG locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

Eaglercraft-ready PNGs

Click or drag on the canvas to paint.

How to use

Choose skin or cape, pick a color, then paint pixels. Use the eraser for transparent pixels.

Skin files use Minecraft's standard 64×64 layout. Capes use a transparent 64×32 PNG, suitable for Eaglercraft cape upload tools.

Keep exported files private if they contain personal designs. This editor does not send files over the network.
